summary: Settings-by-platform table (second part): Extreme IronWare/NOS/SLX-OS/VOSS, F5, Junos (network_cli, netconf, local), Lenovo CNOS/ENOS, Meraki, MikroTik, Nokia SR OS, Pluribus, Ruckus ICX, VyOS, Westermo WeOS 4, and generic NETCONF OSes. † means maintained by the Ansible Network Team.
questions: What ansible_network_os do I use for Juniper Junos?
Which platforms are maintained by the Ansible Network Team?
What network_os value is used for MikroTik RouterOS?
Does Junos support NETCONF in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Settings by platform (F to Z)
answer_card.answer_md:
| Platform | `ansible_network_os` | network_cli | netconf | local |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Extreme IronWare | `community.network.ironware` | ✓ | | ✓ |
| Extreme NOS / SLX-OS / VOSS | `community.network.nos` / `slxos` / `voss` | ✓ | | |
| F5 BIG-IP, BIG-IQ, Meraki, Nokia SR OS | n/a | | | ✓ |
| Junos OS† | `junipernetworks.junos.junos` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Lenovo CNOS / ENOS | `community.network.cnos` / `enos` | ✓ | | ✓ |
| MikroTik RouterOS | `community.network.routeros` | ✓ | | |
| Pluribus Netvisor | `community.network.netvisor` | ✓ | | |
| Ruckus ICX | `community.network.icx` | ✓ | | |
| VyOS† | `vyos.vyos.vyos` | ✓ | | ✓ |
| Westermo WeOS 4 | `community.network.weos4` | ✓ | | |
| Any NETCONF OS† | `<network-os>` | | ✓ | ✓ |

† Maintained by the Ansible Network Team (EOS, ASA, IOS, IOS XR, NX-OS, Junos, VyOS, generic NETCONF).
